recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If maintainers want the stale condition.svg tooltip refreshed, regenerate diagrams from the authoritative source as normal build maintenance rather than manually editing the SVG for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-42978 was an Applied FHIR-core Condition change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification by Patient Care, asking to revise Condition.onset[x] so clinical events, situations, and concerns are covered. The approved text changed the definition to "Estimated or actual date or date-time the condition, situation, or concern began, in the opinion of the clinician." and added a comment that the event occurrence date is the onset date when an event rises to a level of concern.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify HL7/fhir PR #2992 commits c71dae0 and 5475f14 as the implementation. c71dae0 added the J#42978 committee note, updated the Condition.onset[x] definition, and added the event-onset comment in source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml. 5475f14 added the missing terminal period. The current source still contains those changes.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists condition=Condition, so source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml is in build scope. The Patient Care WG Zulip Clinical Event thread shows the old onset wording was the blocker for event-like Conditions and records that J#42978 was resolved. Patient Care Confluence minutes for 2023-10-19 reference FHIR-42978 and that thread without contradictory detail. The same implementation commit also touched FHIR-42981 for Condition.evidence; that separate issue is already represented on the combined branch. source/condition/condition.svg still has older hover text, but it is a checked-in/generated-looking diagram artifact rather than the authoritative source.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The active Condition StructureDefinition already conveys the approved definition and event-onset comment, and a manual SVG-only edit would be inappropriate under the generated-diagram guardrail.

related_jiras.note: c71dae0 applied this issue's onset wording and the separate Condition.evidence clarification together; FHIR-42981 is already represented on the combined branch and was not decided here.
